segments.title: Soya's icebreaker hull and later modifications
segments.summary: An exterior view of Soya identifies her as an icebreaker and points out the permanent hull bulges left by later modifications.
segments.body: Soya is introduced as an icebreaker that has undergone conspicuous modifications. The large bulges along the hull are identified as real, permanent features. Their exact technical purpose is not explained in this short update. The clip therefore provides a visual inspection point for the ship's altered hull form while keeping the engineering question open. A fuller visit is planned for the following day.

evidence.note: The transcript identifies Soya as an icebreaker and calls out her permanent hull bulges as interesting modifications.
